column1: # Craig handle -> display name used in the transcript.
# Handles carried over from session-26/speakers.tsv (same Discord guild, same
# players); track numbers differ per recording, so stems are renumbered here.
# SHARED MIC: Paul has no track of his own this session -- he played from Jeff's
# place and spoke through Jeff's microphone. Jeff says so on the record at
# [0:13:26]: "Paul is speaking through my microphone as well, so there's two of
# our voices." Track 1 therefore carries BOTH Jeff (Iggy) and Paul (Luci), and
# nothing in it can be attributed to one of them on voice alone -- the label is
# deliberately both names. Confirmed mislabels in the first pass: monk-only lines
# ("I'm a monk", "I'm going to do a flurry", "activate some monk focus") are Paul.
# Split them by content during /transcript, with (?) marks for the DM to resolve.
